perks.name: Deconstruct
perks.desc:
Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: No Distractions

perks.name: Repulsor Brace

perks.name: Slickdraw

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.desc: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Withering Gaze
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.desc: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

perks.name: Focused Fury
perks.desc: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Firing Line
perks.desc: This weapon deals increased precision damage when near two or more allies.

perks.name: Häkke Breach Armaments
perks.desc:
This weapon deals increased damage against vehicles and constructs.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Veleda-F is an interesting example of a sniper. It does one thing really well, and that's with the new perk Withering Gaze. It applies Weaken. Given any DPS rotation especially with Envious Arsenal, Recombination, Envious Assassin, etc. whatever you use this works perfectly with Bait and Switch. It applies Weaken for you and your allies. While not a great standalone sniper for end game activities." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Veleda-F is probably the only weapon I wanted to farm this season for a very easy 100 range and handling through barrels, MW and Slickdraw. Throw on Extended Mag and an Icarus grip for better AE and retire my Albruna-D. Being able to run anything in the fourth column is a nice bonus. BUT being a world drop nuked those chances. Closing Time is the nice new perk and can be paired with Lone Wolf as most people would grind for. If you're more old school you can go Snapshot and Opening Shot (as is tradition)." Recommended MW: Range or Handling.

Adamsdown_Boy written v8.1.5 ) )(PvE PvE-Utility PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE utility pick to weaken Bosses and Majors in general, and end-game underleveled content. Unfortunately, aggressive frame snipers like Veleda-F aren't the optimal choice for damage. At base the stats are average - 47 Zoom, 80 Range, 30 Handling is 0.43s ready speed, 0.44s ADS speed and 0.38s stow speed, while the Reload Speed of 27 is a 3.26s reload. With 0/1/2/3 reserve mods, you'll have total ammo of 21/23/24/25 shots (max is 27) and magazine size of 3 (maximum 5). Both Handling and Reload Speed could do with a little help with barrel and magazine perks, although there's also something to be said for a larger capacity mag too. A unique special weapon trait perk combination, for niche use against vehicles and constructs to possibly tuck away for an "in case of emergency, break glass" moment in end-game activities is Deconstruct (×1.4 damage to vehicles and constructs), Vorpal Weapon (×1.15 damage to vehicles and constructs) together with the Hakke Breach Armaments origin trait (×1.15 damage to vehicles and ×1.3 damage to constructs). Altogether, that makes a ×1.8515 damage boost to vehicles and ×2.093 damage to constructs. If you're interested, Veleda was a priestess and prophet of the Bructeri Germanic tribe during the Batavian rebellion against Rome in 69–70 CE. Recommended MW: Handling, with a Backup Mag mod.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 123 from 19 November 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/3n08KP410ui1TXoEdBmsvu?si=79e5ef3228b24096) with @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-Utility PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE utility pick to weaken Bosses and Majors in general, and end-game underleveled content. Veleda-F is, hopefully, a harbinger future void snipers that we can consider in a fireteam's loadout for major and boss damage, even though aggressive frames aren't the optimal choice for damage. At base the stats are average - 47 Zoom, 80 Range, 30 Handling is 0.43s ready speed, 0.44s ADS speed and 0.38s stow speed, while the Reload Speed of 27 is a 3.26s reload. With 0/1/2/3 reserve mods, you'll have total ammo of 21/23/24/25 shots (max is 27) and magazine size of 3 (maximum 5). Both Handling and Reload Speed could do with a little help with barrel and magazine perks, although there's also something to be said for a larger capacity mag too. Air Trigger in the first trait perk column provides the equivalent of 1.5 reserves mods (2 when enhanced) for more total ammo and, if you can co-ordinate starting reloading during a jump, adds 30 to Reload Speed and a ×0.8 reload animation duration. Withering Gaze in the second column applies the same weaken debuff as Divinity - effectively a ×1.15 boost to damage for 6s for the whole fireteam, so could be used in combination with a Boss damage heavy weapon. Interestingly, you can also extend the timer of sources of 30% weaken, such as Felwinter's Helm and Tractor Cannon (but not Hunter Tethers unfortunately) by using Withering Gaze to reapply the debuff. Hopefully in future we'll see the trait in the first column of a sniper rifle. If you're interested, Veleda was a priestess and prophet of the Bructeri Germanic tribe during the Batavian rebellion against Rome in 69–70 CE. The Hakke Breach Armaments origin trait increases damage against vehicles (×1.15), constructs (×1.3) and Stasis crystals (×1.45), which can be situationally useful. Recommended MW: Handling, with a Backup Mag mod.
